description: No process exists for personnel to return organizational assets upon termination or change of employment.
applicability: Applies when organizations lack formal procedures to ensure all organizational assets are returned when personnel leave, change roles, or when assets are no longer needed, including physical devices, access credentials, and intellectual property.

metadata.detection_notes: Review offboarding procedures, assess asset return checklists, verify tracking of issued assets, check for unreturned assets from former employees, evaluate asset return acknowledgment process.
